summary.text: Tony Cabral is a Democratic state representative from the 13th Bristol District who has held the seat since 1991 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a teacher.

paragraphs.text: Antonio Cabral earned an associate degree from Bristol Community College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Dartmouth, and his professional experience includes working as a teacher.
He assumed office in 1991, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the State Administration and Regulatory Oversight Joint Committee.
